lean.fidelity_note: The formal statement retains the cutoff, Bernstein and tail estimates of Lemma B.1, and permits even symbols and every $\Lambda>0$, extending the paper’s radial setting with $\Lambda\ge1$. All constants are chosen after the symbol and before the frequency and field; the Bernstein estimate covers every real normed target space and counts each multi-index once. Spatial commutation is stated at every order for complex Banach-valued fields, and at first order for real velocities, with a separate time-derivative clause; higher real orders follow by iteration on smooth fields. The numbered statement gives the measurable-input $L^\infty$ bound for complex fields and the continuous-input supremum and Hölder bounds for real velocities; separate supplied results give the measurable real-velocity bound. These distinctions leave the paper’s smooth-velocity applications intact.

statements.markdown: $S_\Lambda$ multiply the spatial Fourier mode $e^{2\pi i\xi\cdot x}$, $\xi\in\mathbb Z^3$, by $\psi(\xi/\Lambda)$. Subsection 5.7 takes $u=S_\Lambda V$ as the next parent. The frequencies of $u$ are at most $2\Lambda$, and those of $u\cdot\nabla u$ are at most $4\Lambda$. Thus (B.1) bounds derivatives of both $u$ and its residual, while (B.2) controls the error $u-V$.
